name: Family visa (P category) and family-based RVP

requirement_groups.name: Spouse of a Russian citizen, with a common child

requirements.blocker_text: Requires marriage to a Russian citizen and a common child; this route bypasses the general 3-year waiting period that otherwise applies to spouses without children following 2025/2026 legal amendments.

requirement_groups.name: Spouse of a Russian citizen, no common child

requirements.blocker_text: Following 2025/2026 legal amendments, couples without a common child must wait 3 years from the marriage date before the foreign spouse can apply for a Temporary Residence Permit (RVP) -- marriage to a Russian citizen is no longer an instant path to residency, a real tightening from the prior rule.
requirements.fix_path: Wait 3 years from the marriage date, or establish a common child to qualify for the faster track.

requirement_groups.name: Parent, child, or other close relative of a Russian citizen or resident

requirements.blocker_text: The Russia-based sponsor must register an invitation with the MVD for the visiting or resident family member; the invitation process on the Russian side takes 30-60 days.
requirements.fix_path: Have the sponsor register the invitation with the MVD before applying.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate, birth certificate, or documentation proving the qualifying family relationship
MVD-registered invitation from the Russia-based sponsor
Proof of the sponsor's Russian citizenship or valid residence status

outcome.duration_length: P visa: up to 90 days; family-based RVP: 3 years

sources.title: Russia Handbook -- Applying for Permanent Residency in Russia: Step-by-Step, describing the 2025/2026 'Common Child' fast track and the new 3-year waiting period for childless spouses
Novika -- Russia Visa 2026, describing the P (family visit) visa category and MVD invitation-registration process

notes: STATUS: DRAFT. LIVE POLICY-TIGHTENING CATCH: marrying a Russian citizen was, until a 2025/2026 legal amendment, treated by multiple secondary sources as a near-instant path to residency -- that is no longer accurate. Couples without a common child now face a mandatory 3-year wait from the marriage date before the foreign spouse can even apply for RVP, a substantial real tightening confirmed independently across sources checked in this research pass. This is correctly modeled as two separate OR-logic groups with genuinely different waiting periods (0 effectively vs 36 months) rather than one blended 'spouse' rule, since the presence of a common child is now the single biggest determinant of how fast this route moves -- a structural finding worth surfacing clearly, since many older guides and general expectations about marriage-based immigration to Russia predate this change. citizenship_after_months (12) for the fastest-qualifying groups reflects that family-based RVP holders can, per general Art. 14 simplified-naturalisation provisions, apply for citizenship without the standard 5-year VNZh residence requirement in some cases -- see ru_naturalisation for the full breakdown; this figure should be read as the fastest documented case, not the default for every sub-group in this route. HONEST SOURCING GAP: no direct fetch of mvd.ru's own family-visa or RVP category pages was achieved in this research pass; both sources are tier-3 but the core structural facts (3-year wait, common-child exception) are corroborated with enough legal-context specificity to be treated as reliable.
